subject: ryuka

desc.zh: 琉華在少年时就已取得了天辰流的免许皆传，并将其融入了自己的战斗风格。
desc.en: A master of the Tianchen school since her youth, Ryuka has made its swordsmanship part of her own fighting style.

desc.zh: 社长大人精通算盘账目与各种商约。
desc.en: The company president is a master of ledgers and contracts.

unlock.zh: 角色等级 10 解锁 · 前置：天辰乱舞式
unlock.en: Unlocks at rank 10 · Requires Tianchen Sword-and-Pistol Dance

desc.zh: 潮風武装团由琉華亲自训练，刀枪混合的流派独树一帜。
desc.en: Ryuka personally drills the Shiokaze Armed Company in its distinctive blend of sword and gun.

lines.zh: 解锁属性：为潮風武装团部队解锁先锋部署技能（领主军队）
lines.en: Attribute: Vanguard Deployment for Shiokaze Armed Company units (Lord's army)

lines.zh: 近战攻击：潮風武装团部队+8（领主军队）
lines.en: Melee attack: +8 for Shiokaze Armed Company units (Lord's army)

lines.zh: 近战防御：潮風武装团部队+8（领主军队）
lines.en: Melee defence: +8 for Shiokaze Armed Company units (Lord's army)

lines.zh: 弹药容量：潮風武装团部队+25%（领主军队）
lines.en: Ammunition: +25% for Shiokaze Armed Company units (Lord's army)

lines.zh: 远程破甲杀伤：潮風武装团部队+15%（领主军队）
lines.en: Armour-piercing missile damage: +15% for Shiokaze Armed Company units (Lord's army)

unlock.zh: 角色等级 10 解锁 · 前置：天辰乱舞式
unlock.en: Unlocks at rank 10 · Requires Tianchen Sword-and-Pistol Dance

desc.zh: 在与各国的交易中，商社能让最精良的火药与枪械流转于全军。
desc.en: Through trade with distant nations, the company supplies the army with the finest powder and firearms.

lines.zh: 维持费：潮風武装团、火器与炮兵部队-10%（领主军队）
lines.en: Upkeep: -10% for Shiokaze Armed Company, gunpowder and artillery units (Lord's army)

lines.zh: 远程威力：潮風武装团、火器与炮兵部队+10%（领主军队）
lines.en: Missile strength: +10% for Shiokaze Armed Company, gunpowder and artillery units (Lord's army)

lines.zh: 装弹时间降低：潮風武装团、火器与炮兵部队+10%（领主军队）
lines.en: Reload time reduction: +10% for Shiokaze Armed Company, gunpowder and artillery units (Lord's army)

unlock.zh: 角色等级 10 解锁 · 前置：天辰乱舞式
unlock.en: Unlocks at rank 10 · Requires Tianchen Sword-and-Pistol Dance

desc.zh: 在远渡重洋的贸易期间，琉華写下了新政方略。胸怀四海之人，万邦皆敬。
desc.en: During her voyages, Ryuka set down her plans for a new government. Her vision commands respect across nations.

lines.zh: 外交立场：与帝国、矮人、高等精灵和震旦天朝外交+15
lines.en: Diplomatic relations: +15 with the Empire, Dwarfs, High Elves and Grand Cathay

unlock.zh: 角色等级 10 解锁 · 前置：天辰乱舞式
unlock.en: Unlocks at rank 10 · Requires Tianchen Sword-and-Pistol Dance

desc.zh: 琉華拔刀向天，时代的暴风骤雨在枪炮齐鸣中席卷全军。
desc.en: Ryuka raises her blade to the sky, and the storm of a new era sweeps through the army amid thunderous gunfire.

lines.zh: 解锁属性：心理免疫（领主军队）

unlock.zh: 角色等级 10 解锁 · 前置：算盘与商约、武装团统领、万国枪炮、船中方略
unlock.en: Unlocks at rank 10 · Requires Abacus and Contracts, Commander of the Armed Company, Guns of Many Nations, Plans Aboard Ship

desc.zh: 深海中的魔蟹大多凶猛异常，但有少部分也愿意亲近其他生物。
desc.en: Most deep-sea Prometheans are exceptionally ferocious, though a rare few are willing to befriend other creatures.

desc.zh: 琉華登上桅杆顶的瞭望台，以手枪协同船上火炮与船员作战。
desc.en: Ryuka takes her place in the crow's nest, firing her pistol alongside the ship's cannon and crew.
